title: Physical Damage Coverage Conditions: Reporting, Exclusions and Investigation Referral
content:
The Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) conditions below are the same in all six deductible packages, from the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $2,500 Deductible package to the Cardinal Point Physical Damage $250 Comprehensive / $500 Collision Deductible package.

| Condition | Setting |
|---|---|
| Police report number required for a theft or vandalism claim | Yes |
| Late report review days (calendar days after the date of loss after which a newly reported claim is referred to the special investigations unit before any coverage decision) | 30 |
| Coverage under which hitting an animal is handled | Comprehensive |
| Loss while a named excluded driver operates the vehicle | Not covered (never) |
| Loss while a household resident who is neither rated nor excluded operates the vehicle | Not covered (unlisted resident driver exclusion) |
| Loss with a date of loss inside a lapse in coverage of the owner term | Not covered (never) |
| Loss while the vehicle is used for a ride-hailing or delivery platform | Not covered |
| Claim number format | CLM- followed by 9 digits |

### Indicators that send a claim to the special investigations unit instead of a desk decision

1. The claim was reported after the late report review days.
2. A loss occurred within the inspection window without photos.
3. A theft occurred with the keys unaccounted for.

### Points of judgement

- **31 days versus 30 days.** A claim reported 31 calendar days after the date of loss exceeds the 30 late report review days. A claim reported on the 30th day after the date of loss does not.
- **A deer strike.** Hitting an animal is handled under comprehensive, not collision.
